g.title: title
g.text: 05 · Dynamic view — Ari reserves the last seat, email unavailable

g.title: pre
g.text: BEFORE: W17 — Build a tiny game · owner S10 · published · capacity 3 · S21/S22 hold seats.
Ari (S23, ari@example.invalid) is signed in, has no reservation, and clicks Reserve. Storage works; nobody else acts during this trace.
W17 and R23 are readable aliases for generated IDs; student IDs are supplied by Campus Identity.

g.title: m5
g.text: 6. reserve(VerifiedStudent(S23, Ari, ari@example.invalid), W17) · Python call

g.title: m22
g.text: 23. sendConfirmation(ari@example.invalid, R23, W17 title/time) · Python call

g.title: m25
g.text: 26. Unavailable · keep R23; no rollback and no automatic retry

g.title: post
g.text: AFTER: W17 still belongs to S10; it remains published with capacity 3. Reservations: S21, S22 and S23 (R23). Remaining seats: 0.
ARI SEES: Your place in Build a tiny game is reserved. Confirmation email is unavailable.
Refresh reads R23 from storage. A repeated reserve returns Existing(R23) unchanged, with no extra seat or email.

g.title: legend
g.text: LEGEND: time runs downward; numbers give the interaction order. Solid arrow = request; green dashed arrow = response.
Vertical dotted line = participant lifeline. Blue = application/component; green = data store; grey = external system.
All components belong to Board API; participants reuse views 02/03. tx = one ReservationTransaction supplied by Board Repository.
The storage transaction ends at step 21. The mail attempt at step 24 is outside it. HTTPS/JSON are assumed external contracts.
